backup.title: Backup & import
backup.sub: Move servers, keep copies, bring in existing comics
backup.destination.hint: Leave empty to use {dir}. The folder must exist and the server must be able to write to it.
backup.archives.empty: No archives yet. Back up now to make the first one.
backup.delete.title: Delete archive
backup.delete.body: {name} is removed from the server's disk. This cannot be undone.
backup.export.text: Export everything: one archive with projects, characters, packs and settings. No lock-in.
backup.schedule.title: Backup schedule
backup.schedule.keep_hint: How many of the newest scheduled archives to keep (1–365)
backup.schedule.error.destination: Use an absolute path to an existing folder the server can write to.
backup.notice.failed_body: No archive was written. Check that the destination has free space and that the server can write to it, then back up again.
backup.notice.restore_failed_body: Nothing was changed: the server still has its previous data.
backup.notice.restored_body: {tables} tables, {rows} rows and {media} media files came from the archive.
backup.notice.master_key_body: The archive was sealed with a different master key. Enter provider API keys and World tokens again; members who use two-factor sign-in must set it up again.
backup.restore.title: Restore a backup
backup.restore.warning: Restoring replaces every account, project and setting on this server with the archive's. The server is in maintenance mode while it runs, so members see the maintenance page.
backup.restore.none: No archives yet. Upload one below.
backup.restore.maintenance: Restoring a backup. MangaVeyra will be back in a few minutes.
backup.upload.label: Or upload an archive
backup.upload.hint: A .mvbackup file from Export everything or another MangaVeyra server.
backup.flash.busy: A backup or restore is already running
backup.flash.export_running: Your export is still being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.
